ipeds.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - University of South Carolina-Upstate (fall 2024 admissions, test scores, enrollment, 2024-25 costs)

ipeds_api.title: NCES IPEDS fall 2024 admissions and fall enrollment counts (Urban Institute Education Data Portal)

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator percentages; exact counts from the NCES ADM2024 file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal). No USC Upstate Common Data Set was found, so international applicants/admits, GPA, SAT total and admission factors are not included. College Navigator prints 67% admitted. SAT/ACT percentiles cover enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (SAT 7%, ACT 3%), so they rest on few students; no 50th percentiles are printed. Undergraduate enrollment 4,487 and nonresident-alien undergraduates 62 are IPEDS fall 2024 enrollment.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance for South Carolina residents ($38,823 total at the out-of-state tuition rate).
